title: Games
description: A selection of games ranging from terminal-based ASCII adventures to raycasting game engines and Unity prototypes. These projects emphasize gameplay programming, graphics, and engine architecture.
description_short: A selection of games I made.

So Long.info: A 2D game developed in C as part of the 42 curriculum. Built with MiniLibX, it features real-time rendering, collision detection, sprite animation, and a complete game loop.
So Long.info_short: A 2D platformer game developed in C as part of the 42 curriculum.

Cube.info: A custom multithreaded raycasting game engine written in C featuring procedural map generation, shadows, post-processing effects, configurable rendering options, advanced minimaps, and a Pokémon-inspired RPG gameplay system.
Cube.info_short: A custom multithreaded raycasting game engine written in C.

Sudoku.info: A simple Sudoku game developed in Unity. Features puzzle generation, validation logic, interactive gameplay, and a polished user interface.
Sudoku.info_short: A simple Sudoku game developed in Unity.

Chess.info: A fully playable chess game developed in Unity. Implements legal move generation, game state management, captures, special moves, and a clean interactive interface.
Chess.info_short: A fully playable chess game developed in Unity.

Grid Miner.info: A 3d rpg Platformer with a range of classes and procedural terrain grid generation. Almost every texture and 3d models were built and processed by me in blender
Grid Miner.info_short: A 3D platformer with a range of classes and procedural terrain generation.

Ascii Run.info: A side-scrolling platformer rendered in ASCII and playable in a terminal. Built on top of my custom ASCII rendering engine, featuring real-time animation, physics, and keyboard input.
Ascii Run.info_short: A side-scrolling platformer rendered in ASCII and playable in a terminal.

Ascii Fight.info: A top-down action RPG rendered exclusively in the terminal using ASCII graphics. Features real-time combat, animated entities, and a custom rendering engine written from scratch.
Ascii Fight.info_short: A top-down action RPG rendered in ASCII and playable in a terminal.

Ascii Jump.info: A vertical platformer displayed entirely in the terminal. Demonstrates procedural level generation, and smooth ASCII rendering at interactive frame rates.
Ascii Jump.info_short: Doodle Jump lookalike but in ASCII and played on a terminal.

Ascii Space.info: A terminal-based space shooter powered by my custom ASCII rendering engine. Includes real-time movement, particle effects, enemy AI, and responsive gameplay entirely within a console.
Ascii Space.info_short: A terminal-based space shooter powered by my custom ASCII rendering engine.

Philosophers.info: An enhanced implementation of the classic Dining Philosophers concurrency problem. Beyond multithreading and synchronization, it includes a live ASCII visualization that displays the state of every philosopher in real time.
Philosophers.info_short: An ASCII implementation of the Dining Philosophers concurrency problem.
